notes: «أبي عتاب، سهل بن حماد» is one man: a kunya, a comma and a name (rule 7)
«ح» joins two routes; the second repeats سهل بن حماد inside the editor's braces «{ }», read as written; no tail is shared
«عن جده، معيقيب» gives the grandfather's name as the link (rule 7); «فكان معيقيب على خاتم» is a comment
